purpose: Select nested hierarchy nodes with expansion, mixed ancestor state, optional local search, and keyboard tree navigation while leaving resource meaning to the consumer.
accessibility: Uses tree and treeitem semantics with aria-level, aria-posinset, aria-setsize, aria-expanded, aria-selected, and linked helper text.
Roving focus supports Arrow, Home, End, Space, and Enter without adding a second keyboard model.
Partial selection has a visible mixed marker and an explicit screen-reader announcement.
responsive: Keeps the tree inside a bounded scroll owner so long hierarchies do not expand the page indefinitely.
Rows wrap long labels and retain shared touch-target geometry on narrow Web layouts.
motion: Uses shared transition variables for focus, selection, and expansion affordances.
Respects prefers-reduced-motion through the global motion contract.

api.name: items
api.description: Opaque-ID hierarchy nodes with labels, optional descriptions, disabled state, and children.

api.name: selectedIds
api.description: Controlled selected node IDs; selected branches expand to selectable descendants.

api.name: defaultSelectedIds
api.description: Initial selected node IDs for uncontrolled usage.

api.name: onSelectionChange
api.description: Callback with canonical selected IDs after a node is toggled.

api.name: defaultExpandedIds
api.description: Initial expanded branch IDs for uncontrolled usage.

api.name: onExpandedIdsChange
api.description: Callback after a branch expansion state changes.

api.name: searchable
api.description: Shows a local label filter that keeps matching ancestors visible.

api.name: label
api.description: Visible and accessible name for the hierarchy.

api.name: description
api.description: Helper copy linked to the tree.

api.name: disabled
api.description: Retains the hierarchy while preventing selection and expansion changes.
